identity.title: List of Pokémon Black and White volumes (France)

leadText: Beginning in September 2011, publisher Kurokawa began publishing chapters of the of Pokémon Adventures as a series titled " ". As the chapters in the had not yet been published in volume format in Japan, these volumes are collected directly from the magazine version. This series differs from VIZ Media's Pokémon Black and White volumes — these are a more typical length of seven or eight chapters each while VIZ Media's volumes are only three or four chapters.

This series differs from VIZ Media's Pokémon Black and White volumes — these are a more typical length of seven or eight chapters each while VIZ Media's volumes are only three or four chapters.
